answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method on control tasks and text editing tasks... including sequential editing of text... composing operators within our method manage to generate or edit high-quality text.
answer_1.outputs: Controlled text sequences for tasks like length control, infilling, parts-of-speech matching, and sentiment transfer in text editing.

answer_2.quote: we report the perplexity (PPL) of generated text... We define success metrics (SR)... we report automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, and BertScore)... measure BLEU between human-annotated ground truth and output... Generation accuracy is given by a BERT classifier.
